Write text for the actual A4 overlay layout: default lettering is 35 pt and may reduce to a documented 18 pt minimum. Each panel reserves a 0.92-wide upper band whose height starts at 0.55 and grows with text demand. Keep each speech turn to at most 12 words, use at most two turns, and keep the single narration caption to at most 14 words. Shorten with care to preserve the story's essential event and intent; never omit an event or silently truncate text. The shaped-text fit check rejects a panel if its text cannot fit the actual A4 reserved zone at or above 18 pt. Do not narrate visible action or describe the picture.
